points.description: First challenge is correctly named using a valid term from the model answer (e.g. Adaptation/topology changes, Security, Medium Access Control (hidden/exposed/near-far terminal), QoS, Scalability, Heterogeneity, Dependability, Power Consumption).

First challenge is described precisely and correctly, matching the model answer's specific content (e.g. for Adaptation: nodes move and topology changes dynamically, nodes can join or leave anywhere at any time; for Security: packets can be intercepted or faulty packets injected, needing encryption/authentication; for MAC: interference/collisions, e.g. hidden terminal; for Power: battery-powered devices so energy must be optimised).
points.partial_credit: Half (0.125) if the description gives clearly more than half of the required detail, e.g. only one of the two aspects.

points.description: Second, different challenge is correctly named using a valid term from the model answer.
Second challenge is described precisely and correctly, matching the model answer's specific content for that challenge.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.125) if the description gives clearly more than half of the required detail.

rubric.notes: Full marks need two distinct challenges from the model answer's list, each named with the correct term and described with the specific details. A vague name without a description, or a generic description such as "it is harder in wireless" earns nothing for that point. A wrong detail in a description cancels that description's mark. A challenge that is not in the model answer, or is only a repeat of the first, earns nothing. Do not pay a description unless the matching name is given or clearly identified.
